name: AxCNH
oneLiner: AxCNH is AnchorX's centralized offshore-yuan stablecoin, redeemable 1:1 for CNH and backed by CNH cash reserves at regulated financial institutions.
collateral: Offshore Chinese yuan (CNH) cash reserves held 1:1 at regulated financial institutions; issuer materials describe AxCNH as fully reserved and redeemable for CNH
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 issuance and redemption through AnchorX for CNH transfers; the issuer publishes reported circulating AxCNH and corresponding CNH reserves on its transparency page

reserves.name: CNH cash reserves at regulated financial institutions

mintAuthority.summary: AxCNH is issued by AnchorX Ltd (Kazakhstan, AFSA-licensed); minting and 1:1 CNH redemption run through the issuer's centralized backend against offshore-yuan cash reserves.

controls.label: AnchorX Ltd issuance backend
controls.evidence: Issuer-operated mint/redeem: AnchorX creates AxCNH supply against custodied CNH reserves and redeems 1:1 for CNH transfers; no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route is described.

review.evidence: AnchorX materials describe a single AFSA-regulated issuer minting AxCNH against off-chain CNH reserves with a published transparency page; mint/redeem is centralized.
